about: OpenHaunt doc 14's pixel effects, as bytes: generated by the node firmware's
test/host/pixfx_corpus.c from oh_pixfx.c, and read by the node's
test_pixfx_corpus.c (exact) and by the-pult's pult-render (within a byte).
phase is oh_pixfx_phase_at(speed, now_ms); rgb is R G B per pixel, in hex.
